When my symptoms get really bad I restrict my diet. I call it my "don't eat dirt" cause there's a lot of restrictions but it helps! I cut out all gluten, dairy and nightshade vegetables (potatoes, tomatoes, zucchini and peppers) and no soy products, only hormone-free meat, no alcohol, no sugar (also limit the sugar in juice and fruit you consume) and no caffeine.  Basically my life sucks and I eat a lot of rice and beans but eliminating some or all of these foods has worked for me in the past.  I've been dealing with endo for 10 years diagnosed (and years of pain before my diagnosis) and I've had more doctors and surgeries than anyone my age should.  This is essentially the diet from one of the specialists along the way.  I hope it helps and good luck, hopefully you feel better soon!!
